questions.solution: Let $\begin{aligned} I & =\int_0^{\infty} \frac{1}{\left(x^2+a^2\right)\left(x^2+b^2\right)} d x \\ I & =\frac{1}{a^2-b^2} \int_0^{\infty} \frac{\left(x^2+a^2\right)-\left(x^2+b^2\right)}{\left(x^2+a^2\right)\left(x^2+b^2\right)} d x \\ I & =\frac{1}{a^2-b^2} \int_0^{\infty} \frac{1}{\left(x^2+b^2\right)}-\frac{1}{\left(x^2+a^2\right)} d x \\ I & =\frac{1}{a^2-b^2}\left[\frac{1}{b} \tan ^{-1} \frac{x}{b}-\frac{1}{a} \tan ^{-1} \frac{x}{a}\right]_0^{\infty} \\ I & =\frac{1}{a^2-b^2}\left[\frac{1}{b} \times \frac{\pi}{2}-\frac{1}{a} \times \frac{\pi}{2}\right] \\ I & =\frac{1}{(a+b)(a-b)}\left[\frac{a-b}{a b}\right] \times \frac{\pi}{2} \\ I & =\frac{\pi}{2 a b(a+b)}\end{aligned}$

questions.q: The value of definite integral $\int_0^{\pi / 2} \log (\tan x) d x$ is
questions.solution:
Let $I=\int_0^{\frac{\pi}{2}} \log (\tan x) d x$....(i)
By applying property,
$\begin{aligned}
\int_a^b f(x) d x & =\int_a^b f(a+b-x) d x \\
I & =\int_0^{\frac{\pi}{2}} \log \left(\tan \left(\frac{\pi}{2}-x\right)\right) d x \\
I & =\int_0^{\frac{\pi}{2}} \log (\cot x) d x\ldots(ii)
\end{aligned}$
Adding Eqs. (i) and (ii),
$\begin{aligned}
& 2 I=\int_0^{\frac{\pi}{2}}[\log (\tan x)+\log (\cot x)] d x \\
& 2 I=\int_0^{\frac{\pi}{2}} \log 1 d x=0
\end{aligned}$

questions.q: $\int_5^9 \frac{\log 3 x^2}{\log 3 x^2+\log \left(588-84 x+3 x^2\right)} d x$ is equal to
questions.solution:
Let
$I=\int_5^9 \frac{\log 3 x^2 d x}{\log 3 x^2+\log \left(588-84 x+3 x^2\right)}$...(i)
$\begin{aligned} & =\int_5^9 \frac{\log 3 x^2 d x}{\log 3 x^2+\log 3(14-x)^2} \\ & =\int_5^9 \frac{\log 3(14-x)^2 d x}{\log 3(14-x)^2+\log 3(14-(14-x))^2} \\ & \quad\left[\int_a^b f(x) d x=\int_a^b f(a+b-x) d x\right]\end{aligned}I=\int_5^9 \frac{\log 3(14-x)^2 d x}{\log 3(14-x)^2+\log 3 x^2}$...(ii)
Adding Eqs. (i) and (ii), we get
$\begin{aligned}
& 2 I=\int_5^9 \frac{\log 3 x^2+\log 3(14-x)^2}{\log 3(14-x)^2+\log 3 x^2} d x \\
& 2 \mathrm{I}=\int_5^9 d x=9-5=4 \Rightarrow I=2
\end{aligned}$

questions.solution:
Let $I=\int_0^{\frac{\pi}{2}} \frac{\sin \left(\frac{\pi}{4}+x\right)+\sin \left(\frac{3 \pi}{4}+x\right)}{\cos x+\sin x} d x\Rightarrow I=\int_0^{\pi / 2} \frac{\sin \left(\frac{3 \pi}{4}-x\right)+\sin \left(\frac{5 \pi}{4}-x\right)}{\sin x+\cos x} d x\Rightarrow I=\int_0^{\pi / 2} \frac{\sin \left(\frac{\pi}{4}+x\right)-\sin \left(\frac{3 \pi}{4}+x\right)}{\cos x+\sin x} d x$
Now $I+I=\int_0^{\pi / 2} \frac{2 \sin \left(\frac{\pi}{4}+x\right)}{\cos x+\sin x} d x\Rightarrow I=\int_0^{\pi / 2} \frac{\frac{1}{\sqrt{2}} \cos x+\frac{1}{\sqrt{2}} \sin x}{\cos x-\sin x} d x=\frac{\pi}{2 \sqrt{2}}$

questions.solution:
Suppose, $I=\int_0^{\pi / 2} \cos x e^{\sin x} d x$
Let $\sin x=t \Rightarrow \cos x d x=d t$
$x \rightarrow 0 \Rightarrow t \rightarrow 0$
and $x \rightarrow \frac{\pi}{2} \Rightarrow t \rightarrow 1$
So $I=\int_0^1 e^t d t=\left[e^t\right]_0^1=e-1$

questions.q: The expression $\dfrac{{∫}_{0}^{n}   \left[x\right]dx}{{∫}_{0}^{n} \left\{x\right\}dx}$, where $\left[x\right]$ and $\left\{x\right\}$ are integral and fractional part of x and $n \in \mathbb{N}$, is equal to
questions.solution:
We have, ${∫}_{0}^{n}\left[x\right]dx$

$= {∫}_{0}^{1}0dx + {∫}_{1}^{2}1dx + {∫}_{2}^{3}2dx + \ldots + {∫}_{n - 1}^{n}\left(n - 1\right)dx$

$= 1\left(2 - 1\right) + 2\left(3 - 2\right) + 3\left(4 - 3\right) + \ldots \ldots + \left(n - 1\right)\left\{n - \left(n - 1\right)\right\}$

$= 1 + 2 + 3 + \ldots. + \left(n - 1\right) = \dfrac{n\left(n - 1\right)}{2}$

and ${∫}_{0}^{n}\left\{x\right\}dx = {∫}_{0}^{n}\left(x - \left[x\right]\right)dx = \dfrac{n}{2}$

$∴ \dfrac{{∫}_{0}^{n}\left[x\right]dx}{{∫}_{0}^{n}\left\{x\right\}dx} = n - 1$

questions.q: Find the value of \(\int_0^{4 \pi}|\sin x| d x\)
questions.solution:
We know that \(|\sin x|\) is a periodic function of \(\pi\)
\(\text{ Hence } \begin{array}{r}
\int_0^{4 \pi}|\sin x| d x=4 \int_0^\pi|\sinx| d x=4 \int_0^\pi \sinx d x \\
=4[-\cos x]_0^\pi=8
\end{array}\)
